status: PROPOSED oracle for Qualification to review and freeze. Written before any result was observed. Never edit after seeing results: a change is a new file with a new name and a recorded reason.

semantics.NOT RUN: the scenario produced no observation record at all
semantics.BLOCKED: the scenario or a precondition recorded that it could not be exercised (absent module, undefined differential); never a pass
semantics.FAIL: an observation contradicts a predicate, or a required observation is missing from a scenario that ran
semantics.PASS: every predicate held on the recorded raw observations; says nothing beyond the named row

rows.title: Every component HEAD equals its pin, checkouts pristine, modules loaded from the pinned trees, pydantic >= 2.12
Control Plane decides authorized and the operation is admitted (operation identity, journal mode)
Real provision_local_execution_claim (executor.provision_claim) issues a claim
Route B execute commits exactly one effect and consumes the claim (independent read-only ledger read)
export_execution_artifacts serialises the executor evidence
Replay import accepts the raw CP record, proposal and executor export; all import reports complete
Evidence Pack imports the Replay bundle and validate_evidence_pack is valid
Pinned Verifier on the raw CP record + proposal + manifest does not crash, does not refute (exit 0 accept or 3 abstain only)
No Verifier finding with code journal_check_reused (the documented claim-stage journal refutation)
Any Verifier abstention is attributable only to v4.ledger.rows-agree-with-attempts (route B has no attempt layer); other checks confirmed
Verifier exit code, report bytes (hash) and module path retained for the run
Revocation: grant revoked in the authority store after claim issuance and before effect: effect refused, not attempted, zero effects
Approval withdrawal before effect: effect refused, not attempted, zero effects
Revocation at the Control Plane resolver before claim issuance: claim refused, zero effects
Ambiguous commit (lost acknowledgement): result is unknown, never acknowledged, retry not eligible
No blind retry: re-execution of the same claim is refused and the ledger still holds exactly one effect
Reconciliation after ambiguous commit establishes the applied effect without a second write
Reconciliation route unavailable after ambiguous commit: still unknown, never retry-eligible, never executed
Ambiguous-commit evidence is reconstructable: export and Replay import of the unknown outcome succeed
Duplicate effect: replaying the consumed claim is refused; one effect
Duplicate effect: a second claim for the same decision does not commit a second effect
Duplicate effect: renewal with cap 2 for the same operation id is refused operation_already_committed; one effect
Declared ingress module present and its qualification probe ran (hook contract in suites/mvp-chain/README.md)

Through the declared ingress an ordinary client reaches none of the excluded surfaces (claim provisioning, execute_claim_atomic, simulate, authority writers, raw destination write) and every required surface was attempted
The ingress fixes simulate=None and derives operation identity from the persisted decision
Evidence tampering: Replay import refuses a CP record with a substituted journal commitment (differential against an accepted control)
Evidence tampering: Replay import refuses an executor export naming a different effect (differential)
Evidence tampering: Evidence Pack validation rejects a relabelled refusal summary / retained source
Evidence tampering: the Verifier reports at least one finding code absent from the untampered record (alteration of the decision result)
Evidence tampering: Replay import refuses an executor export whose effect row was edited in the destination store after the fact (differential)
Custody failure: omission of the journal check events from the CP record is refused by Replay (differential)
Custody failure: destination store unavailable at effect time never yields executed and never a retry-eligible result; zero effects
Custody failure: authority store unreadable at claim issuance refuses the claim; zero effects
Custody failure: Replay import without the executor export is not reported as a complete reconstruction (differential against an accepted control)
